answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 7643 Country: Canada Title: At what age should children start going to madrasah? How often should they go? What kitabs do you recommend I have them study in madrasah? Question: At what age should children start going to madrasah? How often should they go? What kitabs do you recommend I have them study in madrasah? Answer ID: 7643 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1187/1046=L/1429) (1) Children should start going to madrasa when they start understating. (2) There is no such limit. (3) The children should be given education of Quran, beliefs and religious books in the beginning. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
